item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli

This multi-journal collection brings together research on entrepreneurship as a catalyst for addressing significant global challenges. It examines how entrepreneurial activities create expected and realized changes, analyzing their implications at individual, organizational, and systemic levels.

The collection welcomes papers investigating entrepreneurship's impact on shaping the future through diverse analytical perspectives. It targets researchers, practitioners, and policymakers interested in understanding entrepreneurship's role in contemporary and emerging social, environmental, and economic contexts.
